title: Lookout — live stylised map of real AI crew activity
desc: Build the actual responsive polished web map/dashboard in dreamer2664/agent-atlas. Original friendly social-deduction/isometric feel but no copied Among Us art or code. AI agents are map characters only when real published observations indicate actual recent work; position/activity/station changes must derive from genuine source status/heartbeat/task events, not random animation, generated data, board claims or roster status. Stale/offline/unknown/no events are visible and characters stop; no invented agents, jobs, chats or movement. Read-only public/credentialless, robust live refresh/retry/cache age, secure untrusted-input rendering, no secret/log/private-prompt exposure. Build stylish embedded-SVG/Canvas/HTML app that works as GitHub Pages and degrades honestly in the sandbox preview. Full charter agent-atlas/LOOKOUT.md; own exhaustive HANDOFF, real browser viewport/screenshots/tests and outcome-based iterations; <=5min factual activity records. Do not create a second crew status publisher.
